name: SalesPad
summary:
Turn any product into an experience.
With svarmony’s SalesPad, you can showcase products in 3D and Augmented Reality — right in front of your audience.

Zoom in, rotate, explore inside, or trigger animations to highlight key features and technology. From simple models to complex systems, the Visualizer helps you tell the story behind every product in a way that’s clear, memorable, and impressive.

Perfect for sales, marketing, and training - in the office, on the go, or at trade shows.
